description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions related to Pydantic models, type annotations, and sequence handling within the FastAPI framework, including compatibility checks for Pydantic v1.

methods.name: lenient_issubclass
methods.description: Performs a lenient check if a class is a subclass of another, handling TypeError cases.

methods.name: _annotation_is_sequence
methods.description: Checks if a type annotation is a sequence type.

methods.name: field_annotation_is_sequence
methods.description: Determines if a field annotation represents a sequence type, considering Union types.

methods.name: value_is_sequence
methods.description: Checks if a value is a sequence type excluding strings and bytes.

methods.name: _annotation_is_complex
methods.description: Checks if a type annotation is complex (e.g., BaseModel, Mapping, UploadFile, or sequence).

methods.name: field_annotation_is_complex
methods.description: Determines if a field annotation is complex, handling Union and Annotated types.

methods.name: field_annotation_is_scalar
methods.description: Checks if a field annotation is a scalar, considering Ellipsis.

methods.name: field_annotation_is_scalar_sequence
methods.description: Checks if a field annotation is a scalar sequence type.

methods.name: is_bytes_or_nonable_bytes_annotation
methods.description: Checks if an annotation is bytes or a non-optional bytes annotation.

methods.name: is_uploadfile_or_nonable_uploadfile_annotation
methods.description: Checks if an annotation is UploadFile or a non-optional UploadFile annotation.

methods.name: is_bytes_sequence_annotation
methods.description: Checks if an annotation is a sequence of bytes.

methods.name: is_uploadfile_sequence_annotation
methods.description: Checks if an annotation is a sequence of UploadFile.

methods.name: is_pydantic_v1_model_instance
methods.description: Checks if an object is an instance of a Pydantic v1 model.

methods.name: is_pydantic_v1_model_class
methods.description: Checks if a class is a Pydantic v1 model class.

methods.name: annotation_is_pydantic_v1
methods.description: Checks if an annotation is related to Pydantic v1 models.
